authError.accessDeniedBody: Registration is closed on this instance, so only accounts the owner has allowed can sign in. Retrying will not change this — ask whoever runs this instance to add your address.

authError.notLinkedTitle: That email already signed in another way
authError.notLinkedBody: An account with this address already exists from a different sign-in method. Use the method you signed up with, or ask the instance owner to link them.
authError.verificationBody: Sign-in links can only be used once and expire quickly. Request a new one and open it straight away.
